title: Preping：无需任务即可构建智能体记忆
summary: 本文提出Preping框架，通过自生成合成任务和提议者引导的记忆构建，解决智能体在新环境中缺乏任务经验时的冷启动问题。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上性能接近基于离线或在线经验的强基线，且部署成本显著降低。
summary_en: This paper proposes Preping, a framework that builds agent procedural memory using self-generated synthetic tasks before observing any target-environment tasks, addressing the cold-start gap. It achieves competitive performance with lower deployment cost.
